Working-Authority image is a Pasti RSY version-3 STX (SHA-256 8d512ac60792eeae7b18afdc724ff27ac6028a1e08f7647e62842bea08e9a2ef, 1031930 bytes). Printable resident labels such as DART II are absent from the STX and from title-screen RAM; they appear only after the title-to-world unpack that fills the $04BD00 base block ($04BD0C=$00E900, $04BD10=$035700, $04BD22=$026000). Track payload remains packed.

164 track records: cylinders 0-79 formatted on both sides, cylinders 80-81 unformatted and empty. Only two tracks carry sector descriptors. Cylinder 0 side 0 holds ten standard 512-byte sectors and an executable boot sector (checksum $1234). Cylinder 1 side 0 is the copy-protection track: 512 fuzzy-mask bytes, sector 1 unstable and failing its data CRC, and a bogus id naming cylinder 6 head 48 with no data record. The other 158 formatted tracks carry raw track images and no sector descriptors, so the game reads them with its own loader: 1017812 bytes of track image against 10240 bytes of standard-format sector data. No resident pointer table, record bank, glyph table or body-label table appears verbatim anywhere in the payload, so the payload is packed and the protected sectors are not a second, directly readable model bank. Reproduced by research/damocles-st/scripts/stx-inventory.py.

Two independent first-world loads and eight live memstates (Eris on foot and boarded, the Spaceport interior, Vesta, Gaea UR City and Dion) agree byte for byte on the surface-assembly table and bank, the building-detail table and bank, the ground record bank $01E790-$023FFF and the $031700 glyph table. All 212 unique object records decode identically in every captured world and no world introduces a record address the first-world table does not already name. Three byte pairs inside the object bank do differ: $03E415 is the $8003 unconditional patch site the three beacons share, and $03AEED and $03B302 lie outside every decoded record stream, so none of them reaches the census.

The object pointer table is not wholly resident. $055026 consumes the world's resident-object stream, writing the signed 16.16 X/Y/Z arrays at $63A8/$67A8/$6BA8 and then copying one table entry onto the entry's own slot at $05503C, filling slots downwards from $3FC. Slots 248-255 are the block the stream rewrites across the pinned captures; slots 250-255 land on a different model between Eris, Vesta and Gaea. Every copied value is another entry of the same table, so a world binds an existing model to a slot and never introduces a record. Slot 247 and below are identical in all ten captures.

Exactly three instructions in the 1 MiB image name $6364. $04CC48 appends a six-byte record to a nine-entry table starting at $636A. $04ED4A replays it after $04EC94 has rebuilt the $ABDC cell workspace from the authored map: for each record whose first byte matches the world index $794E it writes the record's non-negative word into $ABDC + cell*4, replacing or clearing the surface assembly that cell places. $059F64 reads the same table on the negative-word records and substitutes character $DF for the entrance label glyph the cell-derived $7AFB base would otherwise give; its cell comparison at $059F7A is dead, because the $059F7E tst.w overwrites the flags before any branch reads them. So the table changes which already-resident structure a cell places, or one door label character; neither path introduces a record or repoints a pointer bank. The table is all zero in every one of the ten pinned captures, so no capture exercises either branch.

The decoded script ISA reaches 497 ops from all 64 entry slots with nothing undecodable and no reachable inline-native escape. Its only stores are to the interpreter's own state ($7482 records, the $7A42 word table, $6FAA bit records, flag word $7BD8, counter $7BD2, key $7B61, PC $7820) and, through $19, to the script bank at $070000 + operand. No opcode and none of the four native routines the handlers reach can write a pointer table, a record bank or $6364. See docs/research/damocles-script-isa.md.

Interior residents carry a parent and a parent-local placement where their structure group is one a pinned capture binds and the live $ABDC matches the static decode: Vesta group $05 cells $64 (VESTA PARLIAMENT) and $73 (GUM STORE), and Dion group $02. Three Dion records decode a parent but are not placed, because the derived local position falls outside the parent extent: slots 102, 66 and 34. Seven Vesta residents above level 0 are placed without insertions, because the insertion group they name is absent from the parent structure's association list, which is the list bound at level 0; the interior list is unreached (https://github.com/odogono/mercenary/issues/331). The ten Dion residents in groups $1B and $1C are not placed: no pinned capture binds either group, so they keep the disposition #324 records for Gaea group $0F -- bound to a static group record, named workspace identity unresolved.

View-conditioned face groups, $8003/$8006/$8009 header states and object $6000 vector text are decoded as separate forms; the in-game selector for each form is named in the model conditions, not simulated.

Eris cell ground/pad/road records at $1E000 retain $7000 object placements through existing address-based model identities; surface slot zero supplies palette zero for structureless cells, empty records are intentional and add no geometry at $056634, and $F0/$F4 joins remain view-conditioned.

The sky and the ground band below the horizon are excluded as rendering-only state, not omitted geometry: $059CE2 fills the whole viewport in colour index 8 and the MFP Timer B handler at $052280 rewrites $FF8250 at scanline $7BFC, taking the sky from $7C86 and the band from the body workspace word at $7A1A. The scene slots below $F0 that $05499E allocates are excluded on the same footing: they are a per-frame slot numbering over the $1E000 corner longwords already decoded here, drawn as two-point edges at $054AD2, and research/damocles-st/scripts/ground-extent-check.py reconstructs the live list, lowest slot and $5E40 bytes from captured RAM alone.

The documented zero-latch and $F0 post-plan constructors are retained, including the cell-derived door-key label; no discovered record carries an attachment omission. The $DF visual-change branch is accounted for: $059F64 reads the nine-entry $6364 table and substitutes character $DF for the entrance label glyph, while $04ED4A replays the same table over the $ABDC cell workspace to replace or clear an already-resident surface assembly. Neither introduces a record, and the table is all zero in every pinned capture, so neither branch is exercised by an observed state.
Seven building-detail $60xx vector-text records retain their polygon geometry; inline text and live $CCA0 tokens use source filled/stroke glyphs.

Every $6000 vector-text record in the census was inventoried: all 41 set the inline flag and none selects font 4, so the indirect-pointer and font-4 paths are unreached rather than unresolved. $CCA0 tokens divide into slot-derived labels, frame animations whose script is model data, structure-workspace face markers, and one live countdown.

Every resident slot also carries Association A byte 3, decoded as placementClass. It is mutable placement state rather than identity: direct placement copies $7A39 over it at $0546FC and support placement inherits the support's, so a session departs from the authored value as objects move. $7A39 is the 3x3 zone of the intra-cell position against the bound structure's extent rectangle (docs/research/damocles-placement-class.md). The class is not the handling byte's low nibble; they disagree for 176 of the 241 resident slots.

Every body surface carries its base colour and the 4096 x 4096 Surface Cell extent $058F64 masks positions onto; both axes wrap, so an extent whose upper bound is below its lower bound is a wrapped span rather than an empty one. The islands collection holds all 62 records of the per-body lists at $04BD1E, one entry a record: origin, coastline vertices and edge words, the backwards extent/core/exclusion boxes, land colour, structure group, the group record it binds and that group's area name. A record has no name of its own. 21 records share the coastline-less stub whose extent and core boxes are the whole coordinate plane, so $0560F2 answers core everywhere on those bodies -- land, no sea, no coast. The VOID slot's table entry is excluded because VOID is the space-as-place sentinel rather than a body surface. The classifier itself is not replayed here and the nearest-record metric at $056490 is not decoded. A surface placement names the Damocles Island whose origin equals the Structure Workspace origin it was placed against; resident coordinates come from the resident arrays, are already Body Coordinates, and name no record (docs/research/damocles-eris-islands.md, docs/research/damocles-island-census.md).

Every resident slot carries the interaction byte the take handler tests, decoded as handling. Bit 4 refuses silently, bit 5 diverts to the refusal message, and the low nibble is the drop handler's rank pair: bits 0-1 are the support rank the slot supplies and bits 2-3 the support rank it requires; bits 6 and 7 are live state and are zero in the pinned capture. Nothing here selects a candidate: which object is selected is the per-frame nearest-drawn rule in docs/research/damocles-object-selection.md, not a catalogue field.

Every resident slot carries boarding, what the board gate answers for it, with the gate's constants read from the refusal chooser and gate at $0542E0-$05434F rather than assumed. Boardable is the gate's two table facts, the bound at slot 23 and the model guard's single-Y-turn orientation command; the reach, region, Occupancy and VOID guards are live state and the key test asks the Carried Stack. Under the bound the chooser outcome, the paired slot at slot + 178 and the refusal string are published even where the model guard refuses, because the key test runs first; a paired slot with no instance is published as missing. No seated eye height is published: boarding puts the eye at the resident position plus 63 for every slot (docs/design/damocles-boarding-admission.md).

unexplored: The 158 custom-format Pasti STX tracks the game reads with its own loader stay packed: the inventory establishes what is on the disk and that no resident bank is a verbatim copy of it, not what each track decodes to. Only the loaded image is catalogued, so a bank reachable by a load no pinned capture performs would not appear here.
